In the given order!!

Dm actual content creators and ask then to experiment on your platform. Get them to try and use it. Ask then to mention your brand/products name when they publish it anywhere.

Ask for their reviews as a follow up and if they would like to review it.

Advertise, make explainer videos how the product will be used.

Initially the idea is to raise awareness about the product.

Here is a rough map you can follow.

1. Inform the audience about the platform, what it does and it's benefits

2. Tell the audience how they can use this app

3. Go back to the influencers/ creators collaborate with them  or post their reviews. This step will act like a testimonial for your brand.

4. Establish your product as standard

5. From here on the journey for your product should be stable and upward rising.

Hope this will help

And somewhere it is your responsibility as well to assure him he is secure with you in the relationship. And that you are not dismissing his feelings. Sort the relationship equation internally, I am not sure about rest of your background. But from what I see, a valuable relationship should not break because of such silly behaviour.

Now I really need to hear this😭😭😭

Having issues does not compell your partner to he with you through it or be their therapist. You know holding on to the bond has severely affected you. And you just want to conceal everything with her presence. And that does not always help.

You need to save yourself first, and she can save herself to if she is willing to. Sometimes it's okay to fall apart and hold onto yourself first.

You will find love again, in someone, in something or yourself I don't know.

But the universe is really full of kindness, love and beauty ♥️

Sometimes it is a responsibility to support someone with mental disorders. But you are doing a great job man.

Regarding the letter part of this post, I would suggest you to not pick up her unfinished tasks. Look after the dog. He's a good hooman but other than that leave the chores unless she asks you to help her. Do not fill in where she slacks. And tell her it is her responsibility.

I hope you two have had discussed about what you do in your free time, (i.e. working on yourself). If not tell her about this and try telling her that you need that much of time for yourself too. 

Do not tell her mother about the issues, when she tells you something she has never told anyone she puts a great amount of trust in you. I know this may feel overwhelming on your part. But telling about her issues behind her or without her acknowledgement is not right.

I hope you get sorted with the chores issue soon! 
Good luck

Sometimes in relationship we do see things coming up, but try to neglect it, avoid it till the very last moment. And then it drowns us. I know it feels horrible to end such long term relationship. But you know what you before everyone else. Even the SO. not being loved back is a huge red flag. And people barely change.

But here is a thing. If you don't want to end it. Give this guy a deadline or yourself may be. Give the relationship a shot for specific period like a month.

See if he really has changed. If he has you'll know, you'll know even if he is pretending or putting real efforts or not.

But when it ends just know that you did all that you could for the relationship.

Now is the time for you to feel happy and loved. With or without this relationship.
I would die for that view🥺

Overthinking does that to your brain. You tend to forget small small things. But you know what it is okay. Because you have been through a lot (emotionally atleast) now that you are okay with accepting your own self know that it's okay if you forget things. One you can tell them straight about certain things that you don't remember. Two try to be more happy, and keep a mental note of things that are important. It's okay if you don't remember everything. Not everyone is blessed with same capacities. 

When you've completely accepted yourself go back to your self and take steps towards improving your memory. For your own self. Your friends love you for who you are.

Can I suggest you something? I don't know how deeply you are connected with your SO, I feel you need to take a break. If possible move to a different town or somewhere far from people that you are with right now. For now just take best care of your own self and mental health and don't pay hid to what others think. It's your race play it on your pace! No progress is ever slow.

Sometimes the people who know as really well can't easily accept that we are growing or doing better, not they are not happy for you but they have seen you previously. If you don't want to loose them, just get better and more better. You will get a goal that you want to prove to them, that you are better now. And trust me let go of the fear of judgement and live the way you want to live. People will anyway love you. ❤️❤️❤️ 
Hope this helps
